# telnyx_document (Resource)

A document uploaded to Telnyx, such as a letter of authorization or an invoice for porting, from a URL or base64 content.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `customer_reference` (String) Optional reference string for customer tracking.
- `file` (String, Sensitive) Alternatively, instead of the URL you can provide the Base64 encoded contents of the file you are uploading. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `filename` (String) The filename of the document.
- `url` (String) If the file is already hosted publicly, you can provide a URL and have the documents service fetch it for you. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `av_scan_status` (String) The antivirus scan status of the document.
- `content_type` (String) The document's content_type.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `sha256` (String) The document's SHA256 hash provided for optional verification purposes.
- `size` (Attributes) Indicates the document's filesize (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--size))
- `status` (String) Indicates the current document reviewing status
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--size"></a>
### Nested Schema for `size`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) The number of bytes
- `unit` (String) Identifies the unit

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_document.example <id>
```
